newsitem.title: CANADA: CanOxy, Wascana shrs rise on deal.
newsitem.headline: CanOxy, Wascana shrs rise on deal.

text.p: Buyers snapped up shares in Canadian Occidental Petroleum Ltd and Wascana Energy Inc on Tuesday after CanOxy topped a hostile offer for Wascana with a C$2 billion friendly bid.
"Obviously the market likes it. Why does it like it? It likes it because (Wascana) is a great fit for CanOxy on an asset mix basis," one trader said.

The merger proposal, which would make Calgary-based CanOxy Canada's third largest oil and gas exploration and production company, eclipsed a C$1.7 billion hostile cash and stock offer from Talisman Energy Inc.
Wascana shares topped Toronto Stock Exchange actives, rising 1 to 20.35 in turnover of a 9.24 million shares. CanOxy is offering C$20.50 cash a share.
Trading volume in CanOxy stock ran a close second to Wascana. The stock spiked 2.45 to 25.90 on 4.62 million shares.
"The bottom line is CanOxy was looking like a possible takeover target before. You know, a hidden value situation," said one trader.
"CanOxy has been a real laggard in terms of energy stocks. Maybe this will awaken some of the players to the fact that there's value here," he added.
Shares in suitor Talisman edged up 0.35 to 43.95.
